messages:
Maria C: Quick heads-up — PioneerRetail is doing a staged launch + load test next Tue 09:00 PT. They expect bursty traffic for product-recommendation calls (embedding + generate). Contract SLA: 99.95% uptime, p90 latency < 250ms. Putting this on the oncall radar. :warning:

Maria C: Key asks: reserve burst capacity on Dedicated pool for 09:00-12:00 PT, pin fallback model variant (quantized) in routing policy, and coverage handoff for AM shift. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vip-launchs

Jamal: noted. I can take primary coverage 08:30-13:30 PT. Will coordinate the capacity reservation with infra. Can someone confirm the model + seq lengths?

Ethan: model is gpt-large-recommend-v2 (we have a quantized variant gpt-large-recommend-v2-q4). Typical seq len ~ 180 tokens, peak 350. ETA for ticket to reserve capacity?

Maria C: thanks — Ethan that's the one. @Raj will you open the dedicated reservation? we need 4x GPUs reserved with a 10% burst buffer.

Raj: on it. Filing the reservation now: ticket INF-4129. Reservation window 09:00-12:00 PT, reserve 4xA10G-equivalent, burst=10%. I put the contact as Jamal.

Sara: quick FYI — telemetry shows a small regression on prefix cache hit for the recommend path since the last rollout (p50 token time +12ms). Not critical but might amplify under load. I'll attach recent traces in the ticket. :mag:

Ethan: good catch. @Sara can you add a short mitigations checklist? e.g., bump cache TTL for the recommend route, enable optimistic batching, and set fallback to static-rerank if latency > 300ms.

Sara: will do. Also adding an eval run against the new quantized variant tomorrow morning to verify quality isn't degraded.

Olivia (PM): Heads-up from customer: they will run 2 waves at 09:15 and 09:45 with synthetic traffic. They want a Slack bridge open to triage issues. Can we set a temporary alert channel?

Jamal: yes. I'll create #vip-pioneer-ops and invite the oncall rotation + infra + PMs. Also enabling extra alerting thresholds for error rate and p95 latency.

oncall-bot: Reminder — scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC (no conflict with launch).

Maria C: Thanks team. A couple of risk notes to call out: 1) fallback model mismatch — ensure schema compatibility between primary and quantized variant, 2) billing surge — finance has been notified to hold a manual approval for unexpected overages, 3) autoscale cooldown might delay capacity ramp if we rely solely on autoscaling.

Raj: added a routing policy that prefers dedicated pool, then falls back to hosted xlarge-q4 if capacity exhausted. I'll pin the model versions in that policy.

Ethan: for the routing fallback we should also set a graceful degradation message in responses so downstream services can handle lower fidelity. Small PR incoming to templates.

Jamal: Coverage plan: Jamal (primary 08:30-13:30), Maria (shadow 08:30-11:30), Ethan (rotate in 11:00-14:00 for infra escalation), Raj (infra on-call for reservation and routing), Sara (monitoring & traces), Olivia (PM liaison). If anyone needs to swap, call it out here.

Maria C: I might need to step out 10:30-11:00 — Sara can cover me then.

Ethan: I can cover Maria's 10:30-11:00.

Olivia (PM): I'll post the customer contact + runbook link in #vip-pioneer-ops once it's created.

Jamal: Action items summary:
- Raj: confirm reservation INF-4129 + attach routing policy (due today EOD)
- Sara: caching mitigation checklist + eval run (due tomorrow 08:00 PT)
- Ethan: PR for graceful degradation payload (due tomorrow 12:00 PT)
- Jamal/Maria: set up #vip-pioneer-ops and alert thresholds (done by Monday noon)
- Olivia: customer contact + test plan to channel (by Monday noon)

Maria C: thanks — please ping me directly if any unexpected errors pop up during the waves. Otherwise we'll do a brief sync at 12:30 PT post-first-wave. :thumbsup:
